needs_description: The agent is not showing a consistent, robust commitment to a single corridor when avoiding fire. It needs demonstrations that teach staying along the Top-edge corridor (top_edge) even as fire tiles appear centrally and the layout changes. Seeing examples where the agent reliably follows the Top-edge path to reach the goal without detouring into interior routes will reduce wandering and misjudgment under stochastic configurations. This kind of demonstration would help the agent learn a fire-robust corridor strategy and avoid stepping on fire tiles in future episodes, improving success rates.

adjusted_prescription: The demonstrated examples successfully navigate through central corridors near fire tiles but do not show the desired behavior of committing to the top-edge corridor as a safe and robust path. To improve fire avoidance, focus on teaching the agent to consistently follow a path along the top edge of the grid. This means the agent should avoid taking risky routes through the middle areas that come close to fire and instead stick to the perimeter corridor above the fires. The demonstration should clearly show how moving along this top-edge corridor leads safely to the goal without any close encounters with fire. This will help the agent generalize better to different start, goal, and fire configurations by reinforcing a reliable and fire-robust navigation strategy.
